0.reason: every added id was run alone five times per revision on one node, which settles attribution independent of the arms' hosts

findings.text: follow-on: the two arms ran on different hosts (base log line 1 host=98dci4-clu-3141, candidate log line 1 host=98dci4-clu-3142) and skipped different populations (44 vs 10, manifest.md:20), so the 19 added ids conflate a merge effect with a node and skip-population difference; the alone matrix does not resolve it because running a test in isolation is a third environment in which 13 of the 19 also fail at base 0/5 (whole-suite-derive.log:24-36).

follow-on: the brief's checkout recipe (git clone --shared --no-checkout) was not implemented — jobs 1288366 and 1288367 print "clone failed:" in slurm-ws-arm-1288366.out and slurm-ws-arm-1288367.out and the arms use git init plus objects/info/alternates instead — and the substitution is disclosed only in this script comment, while manifest.md:22 records blockers: none, so the exact-spec deviation the role contract requires be reported is not in the record a coordinator reads.

follow-on: the landing line states flatly that the merge adds 19 failing ids, while the node's own failure_attribution (manifest.md:18) classifies every one of the 19 as also-at-base or load-only, so a coordinator reading only the landing line would attribute 19 regressions to the merge that the node's own control does not support.

item_verdicts.diff: no commits — manifest.md:8 lists the two measured shas, not authored commits, and the node worktree is clean at 5274a148; the landed diff under review is base to candidate 24358cca, 19 files changed, +1222/-112 by git diff --stat, chiefly reckon/ledger.py, reckon/metadata_index.py, reckon/resources.py, reckon/roadmap.py and reckon/crew/routing.py.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done-when (prompt.txt:38) requires two logs naming rev=/host/command, proving reckon.__file__ under each checkout and ending in EXIT=, a derivation through added_failures_from_gate_logs, and five alone runs per id per revision; whole-suite-base.log:1-3 and whole-suite-candidate.log:1-3 carry all of these and whole-suite-derive.log holds the 190 alone cells.
item_verdicts.goal: the node goal (prompt.txt:22) is to measure the whole suite at base and at the re-stacked merge candidate; the two arm logs and the attribution in manifest.md:11-20 deliver it.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; manifest.md:11-20 states both arms' counts with log paths, the 19 added ids each with its alone counts and a verdict, the skip divergence between the arms, and status: complete.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the declared scope is the reports directory prompt.txt:58 names, and it is empty; every artefact (manifest, both arm logs, derive log, three scripts) sits under the run directory the delivery fence grants, and no path under reckon/ or tests/ changed.

justifications.durability: no test guards this measurement — whole-suite-arm.sh and derive-and-alone.sh are run once and nothing persists a regression guard, as the node's negative_control none states.
justifications.evidence: whole-suite-base.log:1 names rev/host/command and whole-suite-candidate.log:3 names the module under each checkout, and re-deriving with reckon/crew/review.py:2114 reproduces added_count=19 from the two logs.
justifications.fit: whole-suite-arm.sh:10-16 documents the checkout substitution by mechanism and neither script nor manifest carries a plan label, ticket or version.
justifications.goal_fidelity: manifest.md:11 gives each arm's pass and fail counts and manifest.md:18 gives every added id a verdict naming the run whose files it exercises.
justifications.reuse: derive-and-alone.sh:46 imports added_failures_from_gate_logs from reckon/crew/review.py:2114 rather than reimplementing the failing-id reader.
justifications.scope_discipline: manifest.md:9 records changed_paths: [] and the measured worktree is clean at 5274a148, with every artefact written under the run directory.
